012762: BUSTER_C_INTERNAL CEntityId c_parse_lookup_typedef_name_symbol(CParseResult* result, u32 symbol, String8 name, bool oldest)
012763: {
012764:     u32 bucket = (u32)c_parse_name_hash(symbol, name) & (result->entity_lookup_bucket_count - 1);
012765:     CEntityId found = C_ENTITY_ID_INVALID;
012766:     for (CEntityId entity = result->typedef_lookup_buckets[bucket]; entity.value != C_ID_UNDERLYING_INVALID;
012767:          entity = result->entities[entity.value].next_typedef_in_lookup)
012768:     {
012769:         if (string_equal(result->entities[entity.value].name, name))
012770:         {
012771:             found = entity;
012772:             if (!oldest)
012773:             {
012774:                 break;
012775:             }
012776:         }
012777:     }
012778:     return found;
012779: }

012781: BUSTER_C_SHARED CEntityId c_parse_lookup_typedef_name_fallback(CParseResult* result, String8 name)
012782: {
012783:     if (result)
012784:     {
012785:         // A complete parse has a power-of-two bucket table and a terminated chain.
012786:         // Hand-built or partially rolled-back results can omit either table, point
012787:         // at an invalid entity, or leave a cycle. Prove the chain before entering
012788:         // the canonical lookup, whose hot path intentionally assumes this shape.
012789:         bool bucket_chain_valid = result->entities && result->typedef_lookup_buckets && result->entity_lookup_bucket_count &&
012790:                                   (result->entity_lookup_bucket_count & (result->entity_lookup_bucket_count - 1)) == 0;
012791:         if (bucket_chain_valid)
012792:         {
012793:             u32 bucket = (u32)c_parse_name_hash(c_parse_name_symbol(result, name), name) & (result->entity_lookup_bucket_count - 1);
012794:             CEntityId entity = result->typedef_lookup_buckets[bucket];
012795:             u32 steps = 0;
012796:             while (entity.value != C_ID_UNDERLYING_INVALID)
012797:             {
012798:                 if (steps >= result->entity_count || entity.value >= result->entity_count)
012799:                 {
012800:                     bucket_chain_valid = false;
012801:                     break;
012802:                 }
012803:                 CEntity* candidate = &result->entities[entity.value];
012804:                 if (candidate->kind != C_ENTITY_TYPEDEF)
012805:                 {
012806:                     bucket_chain_valid = false;
012807:                     break;
012808:                 }
012809:                 entity = candidate->next_typedef_in_lookup;
012810:                 steps += 1;
012811:             }
012812:             if (bucket_chain_valid)
012813:             {
012814:                 // Keep the canonical newest-first lookup as the source of the
012815:                 // result after validation; oldest=true preserves the historical
012816:                 // ascending entity scan's first exact typedef.
012817:                 return c_parse_lookup_typedef_name(result, name, true);
012818:             }
012819:         }
012820: 
012821:         // Preserve the original fallback for absent or malformed lookup metadata.
012822:         // Ascending entity order is the language's oldest-typedef tie breaker.
012823:         if (result->entities)
012824:         {
012825:             for (u32 entity_index = 0; entity_index < result->entity_count; entity_index += 1)
012826:             {
012827:                 CEntity* entity = &result->entities[entity_index];
012828:                 if (entity->kind == C_ENTITY_TYPEDEF && string_equal(entity->name, name))
012829:                 {
012830:                     return (CEntityId){.value = entity_index};
012831:                 }
012832:             }
012833:         }
012834:     }
012835: 
012836:     return C_ENTITY_ID_INVALID;
012837: }

012852: BUSTER_C_INTERNAL CEntity* c_parse_first_constant_entity_symbol(CParseResult* result, u32 symbol, String8 name)
012853: {
012854:     if (!result->name_lookup_buckets || !result->entity_lookup_bucket_count)
012855:     {
012856:         return 0;
012857:     }
012858:     u32 bucket = (u32)c_parse_name_hash(symbol, name) & (result->entity_lookup_bucket_count - 1);
012859:     // The chain is newest-first; the last predicate match is the lowest entity
012860:     // index, matching an ascending scan over the entity table.
012861:     CEntity* first = 0;
012862:     for (CEntityId entity = result->name_lookup_buckets[bucket]; entity.value != C_ID_UNDERLYING_INVALID;
012863:          entity = result->entities[entity.value].next_by_name)
012864:     {
012865:         CEntity* candidate = &result->entities[entity.value];
012866:         if ((candidate->kind == C_ENTITY_ENUMERATOR || (candidate->is_constexpr && candidate->has_constant_value)) && string_equal(candidate->name, name))
012867:         {
012868:             first = candidate;
012869:         }
012870:     }
012871:     return first;
012872: }

012874: BUSTER_C_SHARED bool c_parse_type_start(CParseResult* result, CScopeId scope, String8 spelling, CPreprocessDialect dialect)
012875: {
012876:     if (c_parse_type_word_for_dialect(spelling, dialect) || c_parse_auto_type_word(spelling))
012877:     {
012878:         return true;
012879:     }
012880:     CEntityId entity = c_parse_lookup_entity(result, scope, spelling);
012881:     return entity.value != C_ID_UNDERLYING_INVALID && result->entities[entity.value].kind == C_ENTITY_TYPEDEF;
012882: }
012883: 
012884: // The token form of c_parse_type_start with its work kept for the caller:
012885: // the word bits decide for a keyword without a lookup, and a name's
012886: // scope-chain answer is handed back so a caller that goes on to bind that
012887: // same token does not look it up a second time.  `*type_word_out` reports
012888: // that the keyword tests answered, in which case `*entity_out` is invalid.
012889: BUSTER_C_INTERNAL bool c_parse_type_start_token_lookup(CParseResult* result, CPreprocessResult preprocess, CScopeId scope, CToken token,
012890:                                                         bool* type_word_out, CEntityId* entity_out)
012891: {
012892:     bool starts_type;
012893:     CEntityId entity = C_ENTITY_ID_INVALID;
012894:     bool type_word = c_parse_type_word_for_dialect_token(preprocess, token) || c_parse_auto_type_word_token(preprocess, token);
012895:     if (type_word)
012896:     {
012897:         starts_type = true;
012898:     }
012899:     else
012900:     {
012901:         entity = c_parse_lookup_entity_token(result, preprocess.spelling_base, scope, &token);
012902:         starts_type = entity.value != C_ID_UNDERLYING_INVALID && result->entities[entity.value].kind == C_ENTITY_TYPEDEF;
012903:     }
012904:     *type_word_out = type_word;
012905:     *entity_out = entity;
012906:     return starts_type;
012907: }
012908: 
012909: // The token form of c_parse_type_start: word tests by interned symbol id,
012910: // entity lookup through the token's own symbol.
012911: BUSTER_C_SHARED bool c_parse_type_start_token(CParseResult* result, CPreprocessResult preprocess, CScopeId scope, CToken token)
012912: {
012913:     bool type_word = false;
012914:     CEntityId entity = C_ENTITY_ID_INVALID;
012915:     return c_parse_type_start_token_lookup(result, preprocess, scope, token, &type_word, &entity);
012916: }

012921: BUSTER_C_INTERNAL void c_parse_bind_identifier(Arena* arena, CParseResult* result, CPreprocessResult preprocess, CScopeId scope, u32 token_index)
012922: {
012923:     CToken token = preprocess.tokens[token_index];
012924:     c_parse_bind_identifier_entity(arena, result, preprocess, scope, token_index,
012925:                                    c_parse_lookup_entity_token(result, preprocess.spelling_base, scope, &token));
012926: }
012927: 
012928: // Records the use of the identifier at `token_index` as resolving to
012929: // `entity`, the answer of a lookup of that token in `scope` the caller
012930: // already made, and diagnoses an unresolved name unless it is predefined.
012931: BUSTER_C_INTERNAL void c_parse_bind_identifier_entity(Arena* arena, CParseResult* result, CPreprocessResult preprocess, CScopeId scope, u32 token_index,
012932:                                                       CEntityId entity)
012933: {
012934:     CToken token = preprocess.tokens[token_index];
012935:     bool first_use = token_index < result->identifier_use_by_token_capacity && !result->identifier_use_by_token_plus_one[token_index];
012936:     BUSTER_VALIDATE(result->identifier_use_count < result->identifier_use_capacity);
012937:     u32 use_index = result->identifier_use_count++;
012938:     result->identifier_uses[use_index] = (CIdentifierUse){
012939:         .token_index = token_index,
012940:         .entity = entity,
012941:         .scope = scope,
012942:     };
012943:     if (token_index < result->identifier_use_by_token_capacity && !result->identifier_use_by_token_plus_one[token_index])
012944:     {
012945:         result->identifier_use_by_token_plus_one[token_index] = use_index + 1;
012946:     }
012947:     // The predefined names -- __func__ and its GNU forms, the __builtin_ and
012948:     // atomic families, GNU's complex-part operators, C23's true/false/nullptr
012949:     // -- declare no entity, so the only question they answer is whether an
012950:     // unresolved name is an error.  A name the scope chain resolved, which
012951:     // is nearly every one, never reaches the ladder.
012952:     if (entity.value == C_ID_UNDERLYING_INVALID)
012953:     {
012954:         String8 spelling = c_token_spelling(preprocess.spelling_base, token);
012955:         if (first_use && c_parse_bfloat16_builtin(spelling))
012956:         {
012957:             c_parse_position_index_append(arena, &result->bfloat16_builtin_calls, &result->bfloat16_builtin_call_count,
012958:                                            &result->bfloat16_builtin_call_capacity, token_index);
012959:         }
012960:         bool predefined_function_name = string_equal(spelling, S8("__func__")) || string_equal(spelling, S8("__FUNCTION__")) ||
012961:                                         string_equal(spelling, S8("__PRETTY_FUNCTION__")) || string_equal(spelling, S8("__builtin_va_start")) ||
012962:                                         string_equal(spelling, S8("__va_start")) || string_equal(spelling, S8("__builtin_va_arg")) ||
012963:                                         string_equal(spelling, S8("__builtin_va_copy")) || string_equal(spelling, S8("__builtin_va_end"));
012964:         predefined_function_name |= string_starts_with_sequence(spelling, S8("__builtin_"));
012965:         predefined_function_name |= string_starts_with_sequence(spelling, S8("__c11_atomic_"));
012966:         // The GNU spelling of the same family, which takes ordinary pointers.
012967:         // CPython's configure probes it for HAVE_BUILTIN_ATOMIC and most Linux
012968:         // userland reaches for it in preference to the C11 one.
012969:         predefined_function_name |= string_starts_with_sequence(spelling, S8("__atomic_"));
012970:         // Admit only the implemented legacy full barrier and NAND spellings.
012971:         predefined_function_name |= string_equal(spelling, S8("__sync_synchronize")) ||
012972:                                     string_equal(spelling, S8("__sync_fetch_and_nand")) ||
012973:                                     string_equal(spelling, S8("__sync_nand_and_fetch"));
012974:         // GNU's complex part operators are spelled as identifiers but name no
012975:         // entity; the expression walker consumes them as prefix operators.
012976:         predefined_function_name |= string_equal(spelling, S8("__real__")) || string_equal(spelling, S8("__real")) ||
012977:                                     string_equal(spelling, S8("__imag__")) || string_equal(spelling, S8("__imag"));
012978:         predefined_function_name |= c_preprocess_dialect_is_c23(preprocess.dialect) &&
012979:                                     (string_equal(spelling, S8("true")) || string_equal(spelling, S8("false")) || string_equal(spelling, S8("nullptr")));
012980:         if (!predefined_function_name)
012981:         {
012982:             c_parse_diagnostic(result, c_preprocess_token_location(&preprocess, token), C_DIAGNOSTIC_UNDECLARED_IDENTIFIER,
012983:                                string_format(arena, S8("use of undeclared identifier '{S8}'"), spelling));
012984:         }
012985:     }
012986: }

012988: BUSTER_C_INTERNAL bool c_parse_identifier_is_bound(CParseResult* result, u32 token_index)
012989: {
012990:     return c_parse_identifier_use_index(result, token_index) != C_ID_UNDERLYING_INVALID;

012992: 
012993: // One past the `__builtin_offsetof(type, designator)` group whose opening
012994: // parenthesis is at `open`.  The designator names struct members rather than
012995: // objects in scope, so an identifier binder walking a token range has to step
012996: // over the whole group instead of resolving what is inside it.
012997: BUSTER_C_INTERNAL u32 c_parse_builtin_offsetof_end(CPreprocessResult preprocess, u32 open, u32 end)
012998: {
012999:     u32 depth = 0;
013000:     u32 index = open;
013001:     while (index < end)
013002:     {
013003:         if (c_token_is_punctuator(&preprocess.tokens[index], C_PUNCTUATOR_LEFT_PARENTHESIS))
013004:         {
013005:             depth += 1;
013006:         }
013007:         else if (c_token_is_punctuator(&preprocess.tokens[index], C_PUNCTUATOR_RIGHT_PARENTHESIS))
013008:         {
013009:             if (!depth)
013010:             {
013011:                 break;
013012:             }
013013:             depth -= 1;
013014:             if (!depth)
013015:             {
013016:                 index += 1;
013017:                 break;
013018:             }
013019:         }
013020:         index += 1;
013021:     }
013022:     return index;
013023: }
